lines.text: David takes refuge in the LORD, calls Him his rock and fortress, and commits his spirit into His hands.
David hates those who cling to worthless idols, and he says the LORD has set his feet in the open.
David says his eyes fail from sorrow, his flocks are wasting away, and he is like a broken vessel.
Though people plot to take his life, David trusts in the LORD and says his times are in His hands.
David blesses the LORD for showing him loving devotion in a city at peace, and tells all who hope in Him to be strong.
